criteria.description: Finished, unaccepted software-dev board -> blocked MISSION_AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE + next_command accept
criteria.notes: A finished, unaccepted software-dev board answers blocked MISSION_AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE naming spec-kitty accept, through the CLI and the bridge.

criteria.description: Fresh acceptance -> terminal; stale acceptance -> blocked
criteria.evidence: tests/next/test_finished_board_gate_7553.py cells 2,6; tests/runtime/next/test_finished_board_verdict.py freshness table; WP01+WP02 reviews approved
criteria.notes: An acceptance newer than the board's latest WP transition answers terminal; a stale or reopened-then-reapproved acceptance answers blocked again.

criteria.description: Gate answers record no step row (tree-snapshot probe, exactly one blocked/terminal MissionNextInvoked row, no stale pairing)
criteria.evidence: tests/next/test_finished_board_gate_7553.py no-row probe + cell 9; WP02 review D
criteria.notes: Gate answers change the tree only by one blocked/terminal MissionNextInvoked row, start no run, and leave a stale planning-step started record unpaired.

criteria.description: Stale walked runs (discovery, plan) answered by the gate, snapshot unchanged
criteria.notes: Engine-direct stale runs at discovery, plan and tasks are answered by the gate with the run snapshot unchanged; analyze/implement runs keep the engine path.

criteria.description: --result failed/blocked on a finished board never issues a step
criteria.notes: --result failed and --result blocked on a finished board answer MISSION_AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE and never issue a step.

criteria.description: Authoritative runs and other families unchanged
criteria.notes: Authoritative runs (analyze..accept), documentation Missions and Missions without WPs keep their pre-gate path.

criteria.description: One finished-board predicate for query and advance
criteria.evidence: finished_board_verdict used by runtime_bridge.py and runtime_bridge_query.py; tests/runtime/next/test_finished_board_verdict.py; tests/next/test_query_next_command_7553.py cells 3-5
criteria.notes: One finished_board_verdict serves query and advance; both modes agree on unaccepted, stale and fresh acceptance.

criteria.description: Read-only envelopes carry next_command except pending decision / landed
criteria.notes: Read-only envelopes name the advance, accept or consolidate command, except a pending decision on a started run and a landed Mission.
An untouched run's first decision_required preview keeps question, decision_id and input_key/options, plus the advance next_command.

criteria.description: question <=> decision_id; options or input_key, enforced at construction
criteria.evidence: tests/runtime/next/test_pending_decision_prompt.py; tests/next/test_query_next_command_7553.py cell 10; tests/runtime fixtures re-pinned with valid prompts
criteria.notes: PendingDecisionPrompt refuses a question without a decision_id and a decision without options or input_key at construction.

criteria.description: rollback_reset recorded on PLANNED transition with lane_head kept
criteria.notes: A rollback to planned records rollback_reset (scope, reset, previously completed, reason) on the PLANNED event beside lane_head.
--reset-subtasks T002 resets only T002; T001 keeps done and the record says narrowed.

criteria.description: Narrowing refused before any write with own messages
criteria.notes: Each narrowing refusal exits non-zero with its own code and message before any write, with auto-commit on, and echoes operator input literally.

criteria.description: Full reset default; for_review subtask gate still blocks
criteria.notes: Without --reset-subtasks every non-skipped subtask resets; the for_review subtask gate still blocks on a reset subtask.

criteria.description: Announcement names scope and reason (human + JSON)
criteria.notes: The human and JSON output name the reset scope and reason.

criteria.description: Mid-implementation: non-dispatchable board step -> blocked BOARD_STEP_NOT_DISPATCHABLE with resume command
criteria.notes: A claimed or in-progress WP answers blocked BOARD_STEP_NOT_DISPATCHABLE naming the WP and its agent action resume command.
